+@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit_cause", [False, True])
+def test_custom_middleware_preserves_exception_context(
+    test_client_factory: TestClientFactory, explicit_cause: bool
+) -> None:
+    def endpoint(request: Request) -> None:
+        try:
+            raise ValueError("context")
+        except ValueError as exc:
+            if explicit_cause:
+                raise RuntimeError("application error") from exc
+            raise RuntimeError("application error")
+
+    app = Starlette(routes=[Route("/", endpoint)], middleware=[Middleware(CustomMiddleware)])
+
+    with test_client_factory(app) as client, pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc_info:
+        client.get("/")
+
+    visible_context = exc_info.value.__cause__ or exc_info.value.__context__
+    assert isinstance(visible_context, ValueError)
+
